messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling out prompt-router-v2 to prod behind feature-flag `safetyhammer_v2` (canary 10%). Watchlist enabled.

alex: seeing a spike in 5xxs from prompt-router, mostly GET /v1/prompt routes -> v2. :eyes:

mira: yep confirmed from dd: error rate ~3.8% over last 2m, p99 latency +180ms. might be a kernel mismatch on the new endpoint.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: oncall escalation -> @oncall-eric (INC-2026-482). Thread created.

oncall-eric: I'm on it, joining now. alex — can you run the flag flip command and paste output? want to stop the canary asap.

alex: running flip now: `./rfd flag set safetyhammer_v2 off --env=prod --reason "rapid 5xx spike"`

```
> rfd: toggling feature flag safetyhammer_v2
> target: prod
> previous: rollout 10% -> now setting to 0%
> result: success (timestamp 2026-11-08T14:12:05Z)
```

deploy-bot: Confirmed: `safetyhammer_v2` set to OFF for prod. Traffic reverting to stable route.

sam: metrics: 5xxs dropping back to baseline within 1 minute, latency returning to normal. :thumbsup:

support-jen: customer impact: CS logged ~9 customers with transient errors, biggest flag: OmegaCorp saw ~120 errors at 14:11Z; asked for notification template.

mira: error signature in logs: `kv-cache-mismatch` + `kernel: incompatible-gemm`. Probable incompatibility between compiled kernels and the new router variant.

oncall-eric: good containment. Paging cleared, but I'll own follow-up and postmortem. alex/mira — please preserve canary logs and kernel build id.

alex: saving traces, collected `trace_id=tr-8f3b2` and canary artifact hash `sha256:abcd...` and upload to /shared/incidents/INC-2026-482.

support-jen: I've sent proactive note to affected customers and queued a follow-up once we have a root cause.

mira: recommendation: revert canary artifact from today's build and hold any new prompt-router deploys until kernel match verified. Also add a quick e2e test for kv-cache compatibility.

oncall-eric: agreed. I'll schedule a 30m sync with SRE + infra tomorrow morning to validate kernel selection logic. Taking postmortem lead.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-482 status: RESOLVED -> mitigation: FF disabled; follow-up assigned to oncall-eric.

alex: thanks everyone — good catch.

oncall-eric: handing off to next rotation in Slack: @sre-next-rot; please monitor till 16:00 UTC. Closing this thread.
